description: This file defines the CategoryRepository class, which manages data fetching for different categories of content in an Android TV application. It interacts with an external ApiService to retrieve show data, handles errors gracefully by providing sample fallback data, and exposes methods for other components to obtain content items for specified categories.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: Repository class that fetches home category items from network or provides sample data on failure.

methods.name: sampleItemsFor
methods.description: Generates a list of sample ContentItem objects for a given HomeCategory, used when network fetch fails.

methods.name: fetchCategory
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches content items for a specified category, with fallback to sample data upon error.
